premises.text: People have unknowingly relinquished control of their images, content, data, and digital life history
premises.evidence_span: We have unknowingly relinquished real control of our digital life

premises.text: Social Fortress travels with messages and photos on any device, platform, or application
premises.evidence_span: standing with your data no matter where it goes, anywhere in the world, on any device, on any platform, and on any application

premises.text: The same protection works for enterprise, mobile, and consumer apps in real time
premises.evidence_span: Social Fortress works for the enterprise, it works for mobile, it works for the consumer, and it works real time

premises.text: The product is easy enough for non-technical users to keep third parties from seeing their information
premises.evidence_span: Social Fortress is so easy, even my mother can use it, and Google can't even see her information anymore

value.text: Users and organizations regain control of their data wherever it goes
value.evidence_span: They're in control of their data

causal_links.evidence_span: We are all out of control

notes: VPN/SSO/DRM contrast treated as positioning inside the data-following capability, not separate premises. Fortune 100 partners and investor credentials excluded as traction/biography. Yammer/Gmail/Facebook demos folded into enterprise-consumer coverage (v1.3.2 §4.1(5)).
